text:
[Act: cpc
 Chapter: Appeals from Original Decrees
 Section: O41R11A::Time within which hearing under rule 11 should be concluded.
]


Every appeal shall be hear under rule 11 as expeditiously as possible and endeavour shall be made to conclude such hearing within sixty days from the date on which the memorandum of appeal is filed.]

metadata.section_title: Time within which hearing under rule 11 should be concluded.
